answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts streamed over many epochs, say 5% per epoch. Each agent earns rewards that unlock slowly; fake prism identities spun up by an attacker farm nothing during the vesting window, and if the network flags correlated pigment in their behavior, all unvested balances are slashed into the shared ocean treasury that pays honest agents. The attacker must lock capital across thousands of accounts for months and forfeits nearly everything on detection, so flash-farming becomes a guaranteed losing trade.
